description: Source code for RooIgnoreController class that manages file access restrictions based on ignore patterns, using the 'ignore' library and VSCode APIs. It sets up file watchers, loads ignore patterns from .kilocodeignore, and provides methods to validate file access and commands.

classes.name: RooIgnoreController
classes.description: Class that manages ignore patterns for file access control, including setting up watchers, loading patterns, validating access, and providing instructions for the ignore configuration.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the controller with the current working directory, sets up ignore instance, and file watcher.

methods.name: setupFileWatcher
methods.description: Sets up VSCode file system watcher for changes to .kilocodeignore.

methods.name: loadRooIgnore
methods.description: Reads and loads ignore patterns from .kilocodeignore file if it exists.

methods.name: validateAccess
methods.description: Checks if a file should be accessible based on ignore patterns, resolving symlinks.

methods.name: validateCommand
methods.description: Validates if a terminal command that reads files is allowed based on ignore patterns.

methods.name: filterPaths
methods.description: Filters a list of paths, removing those that are ignored.

methods.name: getInstructions
methods.description: Provides formatted instructions about the ignore patterns for the LLM.
